Nina: Heads-up: BrightLane submitted a billing dispute for their Azure marketplace invoice (2026-07-15). They say unit prices don't match the marketplace rate card.

Omar: Which invoice ID/account?

Nina: AZ-INV-20260715-BL78, account brightlane-reseller-78. Their reconciliation shows SKU bl-seat-annual billed at $95 instead of $85.

Felix: Any material amount?

Nina: They calc $7,420 overcharge for the month.

Omar: Possible causes: stale ratecard, currency rounding, or reseller mapping table mismatch after last sync. Can you paste sample lines?

Nina: Sample (sanitized):
```
account,sku,units,unit_price_billed,unit_price_marketplace
brightlane-reseller-78,bl-seat-annual,874,95.00,85.00
```

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4789 for BrightLane Azure ratecard mismatch. Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4789

Leah: Finance: recommend provisional credit for $7,420 pending eng confirmation. Need an approved GL tagging.

Zoe: Approve provisional credit $7,420 (pending audit). GL tags: marketplace_rebates, reseller_settlements, pending_adjustment.

Felix: I'll check the ratecard sync job and mapping service. Last deploy touched the reseller_rules table mapping keys. If mapping falls back to default price, that could explain the delta.

Omar: Also check rounding policy: we had a change to round per-unit after 2026-07-01. If marketplace publishes prices net of discounts we should use marketplace_price before rounding.

Nina: I'll create credit memo CM-20260715-BL78 and mark status=pending in billing UI, link to BILL-4789.

Felix: Found root cause: reseller_rules had an incorrect override for brightlane-reseller-78, forcing price multiplier 1.1176. Rolling back the bad override and re-running settlement for the period now.

Leah: Once eng rerun finishes, finance will reconcile and either finalize the credit or adjust the memo. If corrected ledger shows less, we'll issue a smaller memo and recover difference.

Nina: Notifying BrightLane support with provisional memo ref. Next check in 2h after rerun.

billing-bot: BILL-4789 updated: assignee=Felix, status=investigating.

Omar: Good catch. Add postmortem item: validate reseller_rules changes in staging against a sample of top partners before deploy.

Zoe: Confirming approval for provisional path. Keep me posted if payout required instead of memo.

Nina: Loop closed for now  CM created and linked. Will update when rerun complete.
